ria: hey team! quick intro — i'm Ria, joining as a solutions engineer based in SF. my desk is by the windows (4B-03). i knit and bike commute. also very into spicy instant noodles.
noah: welcome Ria!! :bike: love a spicy noodle fan. coffee preference?
ria: oat latte please. also i carry spare knitting needles if anyone wants to borrow.
tamara: hi Ria 44b welcome! i'll add you to the onboarding retro channel. badge pickup is next to reception btw.
kai: welcome! rooftop meetup after standup? 12:15?
ria: yep i'll be there, bringing instant noodles for anyone brave enough. :hot_pepper:
zane: also FYI we have a plant watering rota in the kitchen. react with :seedling: if you want to be on it.
ria: :seedling: count me in.
noah: welcome-bot added Ria to #new-hires and scheduled intro meeting with her manager for friday at 11am.
ria: thanks all!! excited to meet folks and find the best nearby ramen place. :ramen:
end
